description: Keeps a self-driving rightsize-goal run working until its validator returns DONE, the goal is paused, or a limit is reached. Silent in sessions without an active goal.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/rightsize-goal/scripts/drive.py" hook || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/rightsize-goal/scripts/drive.py" hook || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/rightsize-goal/scripts/drive.py" hook
